Follow the instructions from your insurer.

topics.title: Semester contribution
topics.summary: Check the semester contribution and Thoska fee that apply to your enrollment.
topics.description: For Winter Semester 2026/27, the university lists EUR 358.20 for new first-semester students and new enrollments, including the one-time EUR 20 Thoska fee. It lists EUR 338.20 for students already enrolled; exchange students are excluded from the one-time fee. Check the official page for the amount, payment deadline, bank details and payment reference that apply to you before transferring.
topics.why: Check the current university information for this step.
actions: Check the current university payment instructions for your student status.
Use the official bank details and payment reference.
